task_objective: Prepare a usable offline alternative for an important document.
constraints: Store the offline copy so authorized users can reach it while maintaining protection appropriate to the document.

rius.description: Prepare an authorized accessible offline copy or equivalent non-internet-dependent access path before connectivity is lost.
rius.rationale: An online-only link cannot meet the central offline-access objective.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Prepare an authorized accessible offline copy or equivalent non-internet-dependent access path before connectivity is lost.

rius.description: Test that the prepared document can actually be opened/read without internet, including any necessary viewer, permissions or local credentials.
rius.rationale: A cached pointer or access-controlled file that fails offline defeats the purported alternative.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Test that the prepared document can actually be opened/read without internet, including any necessary viewer, permissions or local credentials.

rius.description: Keep the offline version sufficiently current and clearly identifiable as the intended document.
rius.rationale: Reduces the chance of relying on an obsolete or wrong copy.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Keep the offline version sufficiently current and clearly identifiable as the intended document.

rius.description: Store the offline copy so authorized users can reach it while maintaining protection appropriate to the document.
rius.rationale: Preserves useful access without assuming that offline preparation authorizes public disclosure.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Store the offline copy so authorized users can reach it while maintaining protection appropriate to the document.

task_checks.rule: Score 0 (flagged) for a material factual or operational assertion contradicted by the prompt or justified task knowledge, including materially wrong numeric values, directions or comparators and unsafe operational instructions; cite the response span. Score 1 (pass) if no such assertion is present. Pure omission or insufficient RIU fulfillment alone does not fail this check. CHECK-01 is orthogonal to RIU coverage: the same span can fail both an RIU and CHECK-01, and an RIU failure must not suppress this check.

notes: P02 preparatory AI draft; corpus v0.3.1; protocol 0.3; schema 0.2. All EN/BN/BN-CS prompt strings inspected. All variants require preparation before internet loss, not retrieval from the cloud after loss. Authorized local/offline copy or an appropriate printed copy can work. No requirement to buy a device, use removable storage or expose confidential material. Equivalent wording, script and numerals accepted. Defeating contradictions override positive anchors; genuine refusals/nonanswers score 0 on all RIUs. Conditional safeguards apply to the actions proposed, not to unproposed destructive actions. No independent human acceptance or language-equivalence certification. Production protocol approval and independent review pending.

task_objective: Audit draft claims for evidence, explicit interpretation or genuine common background.

rius.description: Inventory the draft’s substantive claims and classify each as evidence-backed, explicit interpretation or common background knowledge.
rius.rationale: Ensures every claim enters the audit rather than only checking existing citations.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Inventory the draft’s substantive claims and classify each as evidence-backed, explicit interpretation or common background knowledge.

rius.description: For an evidence-backed claim, check that a credible cited/source item actually supports the scope and strength of that claim.
rius.rationale: A citation that does not support the assertion cannot meet the central evidence-verification objective.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: For an evidence-backed claim, check that a credible cited/source item actually supports the scope and strength of that claim.

rius.description: Clearly label interpretations as such and distinguish them from established findings while checking that the underlying evidence permits the inference.
rius.rationale: Unlabeled inference can misrepresent opinion as established fact.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Clearly label interpretations as such and distinguish them from established findings while checking that the underlying evidence permits the inference.

rius.description: Use the common-background category only for information reasonably shared by the intended audience, sourcing specialist, disputed or non-obvious assertions instead.
rius.rationale: Prevents the background label from becoming an escape for unsupported substantive claims.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Use the common-background category only for information reasonably shared by the intended audience, sourcing specialist, disputed or non-obvious assertions instead.

rius.description: Revise, qualify, source or remove claims that do not meet any justified category, and recheck the resulting draft.
rius.rationale: An audit that identifies unsupported claims but leaves them asserted fails the all-claims requirement.

scoring_rule.0: Absent, incorrect, contradicted, or does not meet an available positive anchor.
scoring_rule.1: Revise, qualify, source or remove claims that do not meet any justified category, and recheck the resulting draft.

Score 1 (pass) if no such assertion is present. Pure omission or insufficient RIU fulfillment alone does not fail this check.
